title: AI agents can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations
abstract: arXiv:2611.26003v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulation-driven design of real engineering components has to meet three conditions at once. It runs on few solves, since a nonlinear finite-element simulation of a 3D part takes hours; its design space has many values, the hundreds to thousands of values of the part's CAD model; and a better design often needs a redesign, coordinated changes of the part's proportions rather than local polishing of its surface. Automated optimisers meet at most two of these conditions. Classical optimisers, Bayesian or derivative-free, need a person to cut the design down to a few parameters, and on all the values they need far more solves; industrial shape optimisers move every surface node of the mesh in one solve per cycle, but only in small steps that polish rather than redesign. We ask whether a general-purpose large language model (LLM) can meet all three by joining what it knows with what the simulation shows. GPT-6 Astra edits a magnesium stent

translated_title: AI智能体可以在超过一千个CAD参数和非线性仿真的条件下重新设计工程零件
translated_abstract: 真实工程部件的仿真驱动设计必须同时满足三个条件：它需要在很少的求解次数内完成，因为对一个3D零件进行非线性有限元仿真需要数小时；它的设计空间包含大量取值，即零件CAD模型中的数百到数千个参数值；而且更优的设计往往需要重新设计，即对零件各部分比例进行协调一致的改动，而非对表面进行局部打磨。自动化优化器最多只能同时满足其中两个条件：经典优化器（无论是贝叶斯方法还是无导数方法）需要人工将设计缩减为少数几个参数，且在全部参数上需要远多于可行次数的求解；工业形状优化器虽然每个周期只需一次求解即可移动网格上的所有表面节点，但只能以小幅步长进行“打磨”而非“重新设计”。我们探究一个通用大语言模型（LLM）能否通过将其自身知识与仿真所显示的信息相结合，同时满足这三个条件。GPT-6 Astra对一个镁合金支架进行编辑……
tldr: 该论文提出，通用大语言模型智能体（GPT-6 Astra）能够在仅需少数非线性有限元仿真求解的情况下，对包含上千个CAD参数的真实工程零件进行整体性的重新设计，突破了传统优化器最多只能满足三个关键条件中两个的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that a general-purpose LLM agent (GPT-6 Astra) can holistically redesign real engineering parts with over a thousand CAD parameters using only a few nonlinear finite-element simulation solves, overcoming conventional optimizers' inability to satisfy more than two of the three key conditions.
